principles.unknowns: Unknown values remain absent/null/empty; migration never invents facts.
principles.compatibility: Legacy v2 fields remain readable during transition; v3 domains are additive.
principles.evidence: Facts and support-mesh edges may carry provenance/confidence independently.
principles.programmed_state: Programmable contents are separate from silicon identity. Simulation consumption and reverse physical delivery are independently explicit.

support_mesh_edge.note: No strength is promoted during migration without source evidence.

support_mesh_contract.principle: Parts declare requirements/provisions and evidence-backed reusable patterns; Circuit Chess solves the mesh. No board-specific recipe is implied.

edge_fields.evidence: zero or more source references; inferred edges must say why

pattern_fields.name: human-readable name
pattern_fields.participants: typed roles, not specimen reference designators
pattern_fields.constraints: conditions under which the pattern is legal

anti_hardcoding: Patterns use semantic roles, never motherboard/card reference designators.
Observed topology is not promoted to mandatory without manufacturer/electrical evidence.
Unknown support circuitry remains unknown and may keep synthesis TITS UP.
A part may expose multiple legal alternative patterns.
